title: Chrono revision study: current smooth contact on a 120x50x7 HAMS platform operator

plume.load_definition: Wang 2023 plume_load_n waveform, including 506-510 s plateau approximation

coupling.contact_grid: requested contact dt; platform q and qd linearly interpolated to it
coupling.feedback_resampling: conservative interval-average of fine contact wrench onto platform-grid Voronoi bins

platform_operator.radiation_memory_band_policy: The 0.2-2.0 rad/s positive-semidefinite active radiation band is used in the memory kernel; the separately computed 4-5 rad/s tail is used only for the finite-cutoff A_inf estimate.

added_mass_infinite_definition.method: mean of the last five computed added-mass matrices

platform_operator.horizontal_dof_boundary: surge, sway and yaw are held fixed because supplied HAMS Hydrostatic.in has no horizontal restoring or mooring stiffness; no artificial horizontal stiffness is inserted
platform_operator.hydrodynamic_grid_consistency: A(omega), B(omega), wave excitation and the finite-cutoff A_inf estimate are selected from the same completed mesh level.

wave.definition: deterministic JONSWAP first-order force synthesis on the Barge HAMS frequency grid

wang_baseline_audit.Wang_solver_role: solves platform heave/roll/pitch from F_wave + F_plume through HAMS/Cummins dynamics
wang_baseline_audit.platform_displacement_in_Wang_output: derived state response, not an independent external input
wang_baseline_audit.current_study_usage: does not replay Wang displacement; it uses Wang plume_load_n waveform and a separate 120x50x7 Barge HAMS operator

plume_waveform_definition.note: The 506-510 s Fp segment is approximated as the paper-stated 20400 kN plateau because Figure 6 is not supplied as numeric data.

chronosmc_parameter_that_is_not_used_by_.source: Chrono Stage-1 contact material config from Li 2025 values

review_triplet_check.conclusion: 100 MN/m * 0.148 m = 14.8 MN, so 2.678 MN is not self-consistent with that pure linear pair. The current smooth law is a different law and gives 0.3848 MN at zero rate; even its high-rate limit at this delta is below 2.678 MN.

six_component_wrench_audit.platform_wrench_definition: sum over legs of equal-and-opposite force at [offset_x+leg_x, offset_y+leg_y, deck_z]

omitted_or_zero_by_model.Fx: zero because current smooth law has no tangential/contact-friction force
omitted_or_zero_by_model.Fy: zero because current smooth law has no tangential/contact-friction force
omitted_or_zero_by_model.Mz: zero because vertical point forces have no yaw moment
omitted_or_zero_by_model.surge_sway_yaw_platform_feedback: not injected; supplied 120x50x7 Hydrostatic.in has zero horizontal restoring and no mooring properties

six_component_wrench_audit.action_reaction_check: platform receives -F_contact at the same application point; the reported residual is computed from the final iterative fine trace

interpolation_and_event_detection.q_interpolation: np.interp piecewise-linear interpolation of each platform q component from 0.01 s nodes to every contact substep
interpolation_and_event_detection.qd_interpolation: np.interp piecewise-linear interpolation of platform qd nodes; no finite-difference velocity is silently substituted
interpolation_and_event_detection.feedback_to_platform: fine wrench is interval-averaged over platform-grid Voronoi bins before the next platform solve
interpolation_and_event_detection.contact_event: delta crosses zero; event time is linearly interpolated between adjacent contact samples
interpolation_and_event_detection.force_state: force is evaluated on delta > 0 using the exact smooth law, so a geometric contact can have zero clipped force during rebound

time_step_convergence.definition: two-pass loose coupling repeated at dt, dt/2 and dt/4; peaks use each native contact grid, while event time uses the explicitly interpolated delta crossing

limitations: This is a separate revision study and does not modify existing core files or paper/figure assets.
The active platform sub-operator is heave/roll/pitch; horizontal HAMS DOFs are retained for wrench audit but constrained because supplied mooring stiffness is unavailable.
The current smooth contact model has no tangential friction, explicit flexible leg bodies, or Chrono internal SMC force output in this calculation.
The Wang 506-510 s plume segment is the existing paper-text plateau approximation, not the unavailable machine-readable CFD trace.
Loose coupling is iterated replay, not a monolithic strong Chrono/Cummins integrator; the energy ledger reports the resulting work mismatch explicitly.
